name: address_pr_repair
description: Run bounded remediation for an address-PR candidate and return verification evidence. This workflow never pushes, comments, or otherwise publishes.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the git repository containing the address-PR candidate to repair and re-verify.

candidateCommit.description: Candidate commit SHA to run bounded remediation and verification against.

verification.description: Prior verification result (test_run output shape) whose failing/required commands are carried forward as obligations for this repair pass.

allowAgentTestPlan.description: Defaults true for this workflow: when deterministic discovery is configuration_blocked (e.g. a changed helper file no per-language planner maps to an exact test), lets a read-only coding agent search for an existing test by content as a last resort, instead of leaving the repair pass blocked. Set false to restore the strict deterministic-only behavior. See test_cycle/test_agent_fallback.

allowAgentAuthoredTests.description: Defaults true for this workflow: when allowAgentTestPlan's search also finds nothing, lets a coding agent author exactly one new test file, trusted only after a red/green check (must fail at the pre-candidate baseline, must pass at the real candidate). Set false to restore the strict deterministic-only behavior. Independent of allowAgentTestPlan so existing callers of that flag are unaffected.

agent.description: Compatibility override selecting the coding agent backend (claude, codex, gemini) for the repair session.

model.description: Compatibility override: explicit model id for the repair coding agent session.

maxTurns.description: Cap on agent turns for the repair coding agent session.

maxBudgetUsd.description: Cap on USD spend for the repair coding agent session.

fixPromptTemplate.description: Inline template text (or '@relative/path') overriding the default repair prompt for the coding agent.

fixPromptTemplateSource.description: Diagnostic label naming who supplied fixPromptTemplate; recorded in logs/output only.

modelProfile.description: Named model profile to resolve; empty string defers to the policy's default profile.

modelPolicy.description: Inline model policy document merged on top of the bundled and repository policies.

modelPolicySource.description: Provenance label recorded for the inline modelPolicy.

modelPolicySha256.description: Expected canonical SHA-256 of the inline modelPolicy.

modelsConfig.description: Relative path (inside the worktree) to a repository model policy file, overriding the default location.

modelOverrides.description: Per-role model overrides merged on top of the selected profile.

candidateCommit.description: The final candidate commit SHA after any repair attempts advanced it; null if the optional repair sub-workflow did not produce output.

verificationState.description: Coarse verification verdict from the repair sub-workflow's last verification run; null if the optional repair sub-workflow did not produce output.

verification.description: Full result object of the repair sub-workflow's last verification run (test_run output shape); null if the optional repair sub-workflow did not produce output.

repairAttempts.description: Total number of structured fix/commit/re-test passes performed by the repair sub-workflow; null if it did not produce output.

repairReports.description: Auditable per-attempt repair history from the repair sub-workflow; null if it did not produce output.

repairRoots.description: Write-scope roots the repair sub-workflow's last discovery pass resolved; null if it did not produce output.

agentAuthoredTest.description: True only when the repair sub-workflow's agent-authored-test fallback accepted a new test file after a red/green check; null if it did not produce output.

agentAuthoredTestPath.description: Repository-relative path of the agent-authored test file; empty/null unless agentAuthoredTest is true.

publicationState.description: Static literal recorded by this workflow: it never pushes, comments, or otherwise publishes.
